items.title: External sandboxes for coding agents
items.snippet: External sandboxes for coding agents I've been exploring new ways to sandbox code that is executed by agents, with a focus on making it safer to try out local models without worrying that a mistake or prompt injection attack might cause them to take damaging actions on a machine. I worked on this project with Prime Radiant , the AI research lab behind Superpowers and other projects . My post on the Prime Radiant blog introduces the external sandbox pattern, where code executed by the agent runs
items.title_ar: External sandboxes لتنفيذ كود coding agents بأمان
items.summary_ar: يستعرض Simon Willison نمط External sandbox يُنفَّذ فيه كود الـ agent خارج بيئة التشغيل الأساسية. الهدف تجربة local models بأمان دون خوف من prompt injection أو إجراءات مدمرة على الجهاز. طُوِّر النمط بالتعاون مع Prime Radiant.
items.why_ar: نمط عملي يمكنك تجربته خلال أيام لتشغيل agents بأمان في POCs البنك.
items.title_en: External sandboxes for safer coding agent execution
items.summary_en: Simon Willison describes an external sandbox pattern where code run by an agent executes outside the main machine. The goal is to safely try local models without risking prompt injection or damaging actions. The work was built with Prime Radiant.
items.why_en: It offers a practical, quickly testable pattern for running agents safely in your POCs.

items.why_en: It gives you a ready agent-based workflow to cut inference latency for self-hosted open-source models.

items.title: M3OPD-Reasoner: An Open Recipe for Post-Training Multimodal Reasoning with Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
items.snippet: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) enables a single student to absorb the skills of several domain teachers by learning from its own generated responses. We present Multimodal Model Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation Reasoner (M3OPD-Reasoner), a fully open recipe for post-training vision-language models (VLMs) over three reasoning domains: image STEM, image perception, and video. We curate two datasets, M3OPD-SFT-1.35M for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and M3OPD-RL-193K for reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards. On these data, we compare post-training recipes that start from Qwen3.5-9B: training one model on the mixed data of all domains (MixSFT and MixRL), and traini
items.title_ar: M3OPD-Reasoner: وصفة open recipe لـ post-training لموديلات multimodal reasoning
items.summary_ar: تقدم الورقة M3OPD-Reasoner كوصفة مفتوحة لـ post-training لموديلات vision-language في ثلاثة مجالات استدلال: image STEM وimage perception والفيديو. تعتمد على Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation لتعلم موديل واحد من عدة معلمين. تنشر الورقة مجموعتي بيانات للـ SFT والـ RL وتقارن الوصفات انطلاقاً من Qwen3.5-9B.
items.why_ar: وصفة مفتوحة مع datasets قابلة للتجربة تفيد أبحاث post-training وتجارب multimodal لديك.
items.title_en: M3OPD-Reasoner: open recipe for multimodal reasoning post-training
items.summary_en: The paper presents M3OPD-Reasoner, a fully open recipe for post-training vision-language models across image STEM, image perception, and video. It uses Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation so one student learns from several domain teachers. The authors release two datasets for SFT and RL and compare recipes starting from Qwen3.5-9B.
items.why_en: The open recipe and datasets give you a concrete base for your own post-training experiments and research.

items.title: From Repositories to Training Environments: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding Agents with Environment Evolution Loop
items.snippet: Training coding agents for long-horizon tasks requires environments with verifiable feedback. Existing pipelines often follow a linear process that ends with validation, establishing usability but providing little guidance on improving training value. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) often requires model rollouts or model training followed by downstream evaluation, with costs and feedback delays amplified on long-horizon tasks. How can we use timely, reliable proxy signals to improve training value and synthesize environments at scale? We present RepoFactory, an automated pipeline that converts real repositories into verifiable environments where agents build complete projects from scratch g
items.title_ar: RepoFactory: توسيع coding agents طويلة الأفق عبر Environment Evolution Loop
items.summary_ar: تقدم الورقة RepoFactory، وهو pipeline آلي يحوّل الـ repositories الحقيقية إلى environments قابلة للتحقق يبني فيها agents مشاريع كاملة من الصفر. وتقترح إطار Environment Evolution Loop لتحسين قيمة التدريب باستخدام proxy signals بدلاً من تكلفة model rollouts الكاملة. الهدف توسيع تدريب coding agents للمهام الطويلة.
items.why_ar: مفيد إذا كنت تبني coding agents داخلياً وتحتاج بيئات تدريب أو تقييم قابلة للتحقق.
items.title_en: RepoFactory: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding Agents with Environment Evolution Loop
items.summary_en: The paper presents RepoFactory, an automated pipeline that converts real repositories into verifiable environments where agents build complete projects from scratch. It proposes an Environment Evolution Loop that uses timely proxy signals to improve training value instead of costly model rollouts. The goal is scaling training for long-horizon coding agents.
items.why_en: Useful if you build internal coding agents and need verifiable training or evaluation environments.

items.title: The Noise Floor of a Quantization Comparison: Engine, restart, batch and kernel drift, measured against 8-bit and 4-bit effects in two decision models
items.snippet: A quantized model is usually judged by comparing it with its BF16 original, but that comparison changes more than the weights. It often changes the serving engine, it always runs on a different server instance, it may change how requests are batched, and on some stacks the library selects a different kernel depending only on which packages import. We measure each of these sources on the same 2,400 public decisions for two of Cloudflare's decision models, Clef-flash (9B) and Clef (27B), on an NVIDIA GB10, and state every quantization effect as the excess over them. Sources that are not quantization move between 0 and 0.92% of decisions. llama.cpp restarts are bit-identical on every record for
items.title_ar: قياس ضوضاء مقارنات quantization قبل الحكم على أثر 8-bit و4-bit
items.summary_ar: تجادل الورقة بأن مقارنة موديل quantized مع نسخته الأصلية BF16 تغيّر أكثر من الأوزان، إذ تتغير معها الـ serving engine والـ server instance وطريقة الـ batching واختيار الـ kernel. قاس الباحثون هذه المصادر على 2,400 قرار عام لموديلين من Cloudflare هما Clef-flash 9B وClef 27B على NVIDIA GB10. وتعرض الورقة أن المصادر غير المرتبطة بالـ quantization تغيّر بين 0 و0.92 في المئة من القرارات.
items.why_ar: يهم هذا المهندس لأنه يقدم منهجية عملية لتقييم الموديلات المضغوطة بشكل منصف قبل نشرها في بيئة inference البنك.
items.title_en: Measuring the noise floor before judging 8-bit and 4-bit quantization
items.summary_en: The paper argues that comparing a quantized model with its BF16 original also changes the serving engine, server instance, batching, and kernel selection. The authors measure these non-quantization sources on 2,400 public decisions for Cloudflare's Clef-flash 9B and Clef 27B models on an NVIDIA GB10. They report that non-quantization drift moves between 0 and 0.92 percent of decisions, so quantization effects should be stated as excess over that floor.
items.why_en: It gives a fair methodology for evaluating quantized models before deploying them in a bank's inference stack.

items.title: This smell startup says its AI nose is as good as a human’s

Their careful notes—“nutty,” “peachy,” “marine”—are cross-referenced with a chemical analysis to create a rich set of training data for what AI startup Osmo calls the world’s first foundation…

items.title: Beyond Answering: Learning to Speak First and Act in Streaming Video
items.snippet: Most AI assistants respond only when prompted, remaining silent even when events in the video stream offer meaningful opportunities for conversation. To move beyond purely user-driven interaction, we present AURA 2.0, a streaming video large language model that introduces three core upgrades to AURA. The key advance is Model-Initiated Conversation (MIC), which enables the model to identify topics worth discussing in the evolving visual stream and initiate conversations at appropriate moments without a user query. Stream-Aware Tool Calling (SATC) lets the model act on what it sees by invoking external tools using the current visual and conversational context and incorporating returned informa
items.title_ar: AURA 2.0: نموذج video LLM يبادر بالحديث ويستدعي tools أثناء البث
items.summary_ar: يقدم الباحثون AURA 2.0، وهو streaming video LLM يتجاوز الاستجابة لـ prompt المستخدم فقط. تضيف الورقة Model-Initiated Conversation الذي يتيح للموديل اختيار مواضيع تستحق النقاش في الـ visual stream وبدء الحديث في اللحظة المناسبة. كما تضيف Stream-Aware Tool Calling لاستدعاء أدوات خارجية بناءً على السياق البصري والمحادثي الحالي ودمج النتائج.
items.why_ar: يهم هذا المهندس لأنه يوضح اتجاه البحث نحو agents استباقية تتصرف على بيانات multimodal متدفقة.
items.title_en: AURA 2.0: a streaming video LLM that speaks first and calls tools
items.summary_en: The authors present AURA 2.0, a streaming video large language model that goes beyond responding only when prompted. Its key addition is Model-Initiated Conversation, which lets the model find topics worth discussing in the visual stream and start conversations at suitable moments. It also adds Stream-Aware Tool Calling to invoke external tools using the current visual and conversational context.
items.why_en: It is relevant as a research direction for proactive agents that act on live multimodal input.

items.title: TPHC: Improving Hyper-Connections with Tensor-Parallel Grouped Updates
items.snippet: Hyper-Connections (HC) expand the residual stream of a Transformer into N parallel streams, and manifold-constrained HC (mHC) stabilizes them at scale. However, mHC benefits little from more than four streams, partly because each sublayer writes a single output to all streams, limiting how differently they can be updated. In this work, we propose TPHC, which integrates tensor-parallel (TP) shards with HC streams to promote greater independence across streams. Specifically, we route a separate mixture of the residual streams to each TP shard and keep the individual shard outputs separate during write-back, so each stream can receive a different mixture of those outputs. This design makes the
items.title_ar: TPHC: تحسين Hyper-Connections عبر تحديثات tensor-parallel مجمّعة
items.summary_ar: تقترح الورقة TPHC التي تدمج tensor-parallel shards مع HC streams لزيادة استقلالية الـ streams عن بعضها. يوجّه كل shard مزيجاً مختلفاً من residual streams ويحتفظ بمخرجاته منفصلة أثناء write-back، فيحصل كل stream على مزيج مختلف من المخرجات. الدافع أن mHC لا يستفيد كثيراً عند تجاوز أربعة streams.
items.why_ar: يهمك لأنه تعديل معماري على Transformer قد يؤثر على طريقة تدريب وتوسيع موديلات LLM.
items.title_en: TPHC: Improving Hyper-Connections with Tensor-Parallel Grouped Updates
items.summary_en: The paper proposes TPHC, which integrates tensor-parallel shards with Hyper-Connections streams to make streams more independent. Each TP shard receives a separate mixture of residual streams, and shard outputs stay separate during write-back so each stream gets a different mixture. It targets the limited benefit mHC sees beyond four streams.
items.why_en: It is an architectural change to the Transformer residual stream that could shape how you think about training and scaling LLMs.

items.snippet: إس إيه بي": الذكاء الاصطناعي يعيد رسم ملامح الوظائف في السعودية ويفرض مهارات جديدة Zawya
items.title_ar: AI يعيد رسم ملامح الوظائف في السعودية ويفرض مهارات جديدة
items.summary_ar: تناول تقرير من Zawya تأثير AI على سوق العمل في السعودية، مع التركيز على تغير طبيعة الوظائف. يشير التقرير إلى ظهور مهارات جديدة يحتاجها الموظفون للتكيف مع هذا التحول.
items.why_ar: يوضح التحول في متطلبات المهارات داخل سوق العمل السعودي، وهو سياق مفيد لفهم الكفاءات التي يحتاجها فريق AI في القطاع المالي.
items.title_en: AI reshapes Saudi jobs and demands new skills
items.summary_en: A Zawya report examines how AI is reshaping jobs in Saudi Arabia. It highlights new skills that workers will need to adapt to this shift.
items.why_en: It gives context on the skills shift in the Saudi job market, which matters for AI talent planning at a Saudi bank.
